purpose: Только предварительная диагностика локального малого предприятия по сохранённым/законно доступным публичным наблюдениям; без контакта, новых платных запросов и вывода о доходах.

inputContract.caseIdPolicy: Use existing YAAI workspace safeConfigId; do not construct raw paths from user text.
inputContract.sourceIds: Nonempty unique IDs within case; sourceId is a pointer to permitted archived/public observation, never a proof of truth.
inputContract.limits: All metrics require period, region, unit; null is unknown, not zero.

steps.intent: Record niche, geography, target buyer, ICP and disqualifiers.
Verify prospect identity/activity via permitted business/site sources; separate absence in a query from absence in reality.
Only cite observed accessible pages, navigation, offering, contact funnel, broken elements and timestamps. No private conversion claims.
Contrast same region/date/service type with 0–3 relevant direct businesses; distinguish marketplace, directory and SEO rival.
Search archived evidence for contradicting observations, newer revisions, company replies and material context; mark unresolved issues.
Pick smallest source-grounded opportunity or explicitly abstain; hypothetical examples must not become business facts.
If status is propose_draft: write one specific low-risk, reviewed offer based on existing public observations; do not contact.
Link every finding to case/source/snapshot/time/playbook version for eventual P0-C persistence; no writes in P0-B.3.

decisionRules.propose_draft: At least one observable and reproducible actionable finding with a valid source/date; material contradictions resolved; suggested improvement does not depend on private revenue or speculative traffic. All claims cited. Independently contextualized comparisons preferred but not mandatory to fix an observed broken element.
decisionRules.hold_for_review: Material contradictions, doubtful source freshness or attribution, or uncertain business identity invalidate decisive claim; no sales diagnosis or outreach proposal.
decisionRules.insufficient_evidence: No verifiable actionable observation tied to prospect; only SERP absence, general Wordstat intent, or missing data; do not invent a weakness.

qualityDecision.invariant: No auto-contact, no false 'confirmed conversion losses' and no unsupported numerical benefits

provenance.sourceIdentity: caseId + sourceId + URL or archive reference + observedAt

semantics.serp_snippet: search excerpt, NOT a full review

compatibility.evidenceReportV1: Only for source='yaai-evidence-report' AND reportType='pain-discovery'; operator audit is a distinct future data type, never masquerade as Pain Discovery report.
compatibility.MCP: No new MCP method in P0-B.3; P0-D/E will reuse persisted task contracts.
compatibility.studio: No new Studio endpoint in P0-B.3.

upstreamMethodology.usage: Adapt general structure, not API calls or formula thresholds
Preserve existing semantic and provenance guardrails

testPolicy.futureBenchmark: P0-B.4: 10–20 human-labelled examples; P0-B.5: baseline comparison
